decision: Amend product-identity to accept a consumer-supplied node, name and optional home destination, replacing the ProductMark requirement and Logo/Avatar exclusion.

evidence.channel: Owner decision forwarded in odd/tasks/organisms-build.md L14, 2026-11-01
evidence.interpretation: Explicit convention approval reported by the parent; this is not a signed or independent receipt.

before.meaning: Identity of the EGDEV product or application that a structural region presents: its compact brand monogram, its visible and accessible name, and an optional home destination.
before.whenToUse: An application region such as a sidebar shows which product the user is in by rendering ProductMark with the product's name, optionally linking to the product's home.
before.avoid: The egdev corporate logo (use Logo), people or channel identities (use Avatar), page or section headings (use title), or accessible names of controls (use label).

after.meaning: Identity of a product or application presented by a structural region: a consumer-supplied node, its visible and accessible name, and an optional home destination.
after.whenToUse: An application region such as a sidebar presents a product using consumer-supplied artwork such as Logo, Avatar or another node, its name and optionally its home destination.
after.avoid: Page or section headings (use title), accessible names of controls (use label), or assuming a specific artwork component.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Product identity only; no new component, token, dependency or automatic migration.

convention.name: product
convention.meaning: Identity of a product or application presented by a structural region: a consumer-supplied node, its visible and accessible name, and an optional home destination.
convention.whenToUse: An application region such as a sidebar presents a product using consumer-supplied artwork such as Logo, Avatar or another node, its name and optionally its home destination.
convention.avoid: Page or section headings (use title), accessible names of controls (use label), or assuming a specific artwork component.
